captions.text: In one year,
Indian families filed over twenty six thousand complaints of unfair selling against life insurers.
Kanakku is a money adviser for families. It checks insurance, loans,
stock tips and scam calls before you pay.

shots.title: Show the paper. Ask the question.
shots.text: Any brochure, loan offer or tip, by voice or by typing.

captions.text: Lakshmi shows the agent's brochure,
and asks if fifteen lakh is really guaranteed.

shots.title: The council gets to work
shots.note: Shown 4.5x faster. This answer took 50 s.

captions.text: Muse Spark reads the paper. Code does every sum.
The model never writes a number.
The answer is stop, with the exact questions to ask the agent.

shots.title: Only 7.5 lakh is guaranteed
shots.text: Dani and Sankz argue from code-computed facts.

The seller's claim is checked against the paper,
and every amount shows where it came from.
Her own figures stay on her screen.
